**DAWters and Son 2.3.4** — the whole recording studio, free. No tiers, no sign-up, no tracking.

This is the first public release, now free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

| Your computer | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Mac (Apple Silicon, macOS 12+) | `DAWters-and-Son-2.3.4-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `DAWters-and-Son-2.3.4-Setup-x64.exe`, or the portable `.zip` |
| Ubuntu / Debian (64-bit) | `DAWters-and-Son-2.3.4-amd64.deb` |
| Android 7+ | `DAWters-and-Son-2.3.4.apk` |
| Any browser, offline | `DAWters-and-Son-2.3.4-web.zip` (or use it online, no download) |

**First launch:** the Mac and Windows builds aren't code-signed yet. On a Mac, open the app once, then go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click *Open Anyway*. On Windows, if SmartScreen appears, click *More info › Run anyway*.

**What's new in 2.3.4:** Crash and Ride pads on the drum synth, and a fix so a pattern placed on the timeline plays where it sits after you've used Loop. 2.3.3 put the GPL license in every download and under Help › About › License.

SHA-256 checksums for every file are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
